noise_correction.assumption: non-differential contamination: a mislabelled row's score behaves like a typical row of its TRUE class
noise_correction.formula: with a = contamination of the ERROR side (1 - ERROR_CERT precision) and b = contamination of the MAPPED side (1 - MAPPED faithful share): AUROC_obs = A (1-b)(1-2a) + a(1-b) + b/2, so A = (AUROC_obs - a(1-b) - b/2) / ((1-b)(1-2a)) and delta_true = delta_obs / ((1-b)(1-2a)); the sign of a paired delta is invariant, its magnitude is inflated
noise_correction.inputs: a and b from the blind audit (auditor consensus rows, Sonnet-only and GLM-only as bounds) and from the dataset-5 executor audit (0.867 each)
noise_correction.differential_check: s1a/s1b drop the out-of-family faithful forms (the known differential contamination on the ERROR side); audited contaminants' mean scores vs their labelled class are reported

audit_labelled_view.statistics: within-template AUROC and paired deltas c_score_align - judge (both views), template-stratified sentence bootstrap B=2000 seed 20260924
